items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: He was good, yeah. Well, I know him a twine, there was no read.

ctx.x: Yeah. And bootleggers time, I was around 19. Yeah. You still had a chance. You still got them now, for that concern. Yeah, I guess.

Mm-hmm. I wonder if there's anything else you can tell us about the early drummers when you were a boy, even before you took up music. You mentioned, of course, your teacher, Cantrell. Cantrell. But some of the other early drummers. Walter Brunson.
